$comment: Bowie's own indicator settings, from the TradingView script 'Ichimoku Kinko Hyo Cloud - no offset - no repaint' by KryptoNight. See docs/SPEC.md section 3.

ichimoku.$shiftNote: Plotted shift = displacement - extraBars = 34. Verified against the script's Pine source; matches TradingView's own off-by-one.
ichimoku.$senkouASourceNote: RESOLVED 2026-09-20 from the Pine source: leadingSpanA = avg(conversion, baseline) = (tenkan + kijun) / 2. The auxiliary base line is plot-only and feeds no formula.
ichimoku.$cloudModeNote: OPEN POINT E - the script draws BOTH a standard displaced cloud and a 'no offset' cloud. 'displaced' = classic Ichimoku, cloud at bar t comes from senkou[t-34]. 'noOffset' = cloud at bar t comes from senkou[t]. Both are computed; this selects which one drives the table and the score.

usage.$comment: Exactly which EMA is used on which timeframe. Cells not listed are never shown and never scored.
